description:
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Saffi.
Activate the Saffi token by sacrificing it, targeting the nontoken Saffi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Saffi, adding {1}.
When the nontoken Saffi dies, the token Saffi triggers, returning the nontoken Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
